Streaming chat completion with tool/function call chunks

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What's the weather?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"tools\":[{\"function\":{\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"city\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"function\"}]}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chatStream(req: _req)
var chunks: [LiterLlm.ChatCompletionChunk] = []
        for try await _chunk in result { chunks.append(_chunk) }
print(result)
```
